title: Rim Brakes Aren’t Dead (And They Now Clear 40mm Tires)
content:
Think the industry has completely moved on to discs? Firefly's latest custom titanium build brings electronic shifting and huge tire clearance back to the rim brake.

Read the full article at Rim Brakes Aren’t Dead (And They Now Clear 40mm Tires) on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
